script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet of the water element, is forming a tense square to Mercury in your 3rd House of Communication, stirring confusion in your daily conversations. At the same time, Mars is opposing your natal Neptune, creating a surge of energy in your 12th House of secrets and subconscious patterns. If you're single, the Venus-Neptune trine in your 7th House of partnerships invites a dreamy, romantic encounter; if you're taken, watch for unresolved fantasies clouding your commitment. Your 10th House of career is lit by a Jupiter-Saturn conjunction, offering a breakthrough opportunity, but be cautious with financial decisions in your 2nd House of income as Mercury squares your natal Mars. Beware of letting intuition override logic in your 6th House of health, or you may overlook a hidden blessing. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
